description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945008557478 RELAY,ELECTROMAGNET: Line 0001 Qty 750 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0106 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 4. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 112. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 11083 9F-3099; 75Q65 16900FX1; 75Q65 D014Y192; F8357 UPCAT353. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
